subject: Replace prose agreement with a four-path proof parity ring

body.text: Generalize the successful dual-key rendezvous into an error-detecting parity ring over one exact physical/model occurrence Ω. Four independent projections should derive the same sorted identity set and evidence closure: (A) terminal_epoch_receipt/v6 replay, (B) FinancialMetabolism canonical query, (C) Bonfyre semantic shell traversal, (D) WorkGraph/EvidenceGraph realization lineage. Each path emits only semantic refs plus a deterministic digest of the normalized identity/cardinality/unknown-field set. A non-originating epoch compares the four digests. All-equal is review evidence, not new authority. Any mismatch is a syndrome: emit trace_divergence naming the first disagreeing edge/layer. Add metamorphic checks: changing only price evidence may alter EconomicMeasure but not UsageOccurrence identity; changing only shell presentation may not alter finance; missing model_ref remains missing across all paths. This turns cross-agent communication into algebraic parity rather than status prose.
